concept_gloss.text: toplumsal itibar, yüksek mevki ve önde gelen kişi

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin topluluk içinde sahip olduğu yüksek mevki, değer ve saygınlıktır; ayrıca bir topluluğun önderini veya bir yerin önde gelen kişilerini belirtir.

facets.statement: Kişinin başkaları yanındaki toplumsal mevki, değer ve saygınlığını belirtir.
Bir topluluğun önderini veya bir yerin seçkin ve önde gelen kişilerini belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin toplumsal konumu ve başkaları yanındaki değeri anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel saygınlık ve yüksek mevki anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun veya yerleşimin önde gelen seçkin kişileri anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk içinde önder ve seçkin kişiler anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki önde olma fiziksel ön yüz değil, toplumsal mevki, saygınlık ve önderliktir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin toplulukta veya yönetici yanında sahip olduğu mevki ve değeri, ayrıca topluluğun ya da yerleşimin önde gelenlerini açıkça birlikte verir. Dalın itibar ve önderlik çerçevesi bu toplumsal kapsamı doğru yansıtır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onu itibarlı ve yüksek mevkili kılmak

lexicalization_scope.note: Toplumsal mevki çekirdeği ile önde gelen kişi ve topluluk ileri gelenleri bildiren kalıplar ayrı ama bağlantılı biçimde tanımlanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm komşular değerlendirildi; genel yücelik ile yakınlıktan doğan mevki, toplumsal itibarın iki temel sınırını gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toplumsal mevkiyi ve bu mevkiyi taşıyan önder kişileri adlandırır; komşu dal daha genel yücelik ve şeref alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Topluluk önderi ve bir yerin ileri gelenleri gibi kişi adlandırmaları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel yücelik, şeref ve derece yüksekliği daha geniş biçimde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin yüksek değeri ve şerefli konumunu anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toplum içindeki itibar ve önderliği anlatır; komşu dal birine yakın bulunmaktan doğan derece ve gözde olma ilişkisini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Önderlik, seçkinlik ve yüksek toplumsal değer bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir başkasına yakınlık, onun yanındaki derece ve gözde olma komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin başkaları yanındaki değerli konumunu gösterebilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: وجيه بين الجاه والجاه مقلوب (maqayis); وجوه القوم سادتهم ورجل وجيه عند السلطان (jamhara); صار وجيها أي ذا جاه وقدر ووجوه البلد أشرافه (sihah); جاه فيهم أي منزلة وقدر (tahdhib); فلان وجه القوم وفلان وجيه ذو جاه (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar toplumsal mevki ve değer anlamında birleşir; önder ve ileri gelenler anlatımı bu mevkinin kişiler veya topluluk içindeki taşıyıcılarını adlandırır.

branches.what_is_ar: الوجاهة؛ الجاه والمنزلة والقدر؛ وجه القوم ووجوه البلد أي أشرافهم وسادتهم
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجارحة ولا الجهة المكانية

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız günün başlangıcını bildiren kaynakta verilen zaman kalıbı için geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Günün ilk bölümü olma ve kalıba bağlılık sınırını korur.

concept_gloss.text: günün başı, ilk saatleri

concept_map.definition: Günün ilk bölümü, yani günün başlangıcıdır; anlam yalnız bu zaman bildiren kuruluş içinde geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Günün başlangıcını ve ilk bölümünü belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın günün başlangıcında gerçekleştiğini doğal akışta belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Günün başlangıcındaki zaman konumunu korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız günün ilk bölümüyle ilgilidir; genel başlangıç veya üstünlük anlamına genişletilmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız günün başını ve ilk bölümünü bildiren belirli bir kalıbı destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki her şeyin başlangıcı veya en değerli görünen yanı biçimindeki genelleme kaynak ifadesinde yer almadığından dal bu kalıpla sınırlandırılmıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız günün başlangıcını bildiren sabit kuruluşa bağlıdır ve yalın bir kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; sabah vakti ve genel başlangıç dalları, kalıbın zamanla sınırlı kapsamını en iyi ortaya koyar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir kuruluşla günün başını adlandırır; komşu dal sabah vaktini ve o vakitte yapılan erken hareketleri daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir kalıp yalnız günün ilk bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sabah vakti yanında erken çıkma, erken yol alma ve bir işe çabuk davranma eylemleri de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da günün erken bölümünü zaman olarak gösterebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal günün başıyla sınırlı bir zaman kalıbıdır; komşu dal başlangıç anlamını farklı varlık ve süreçlere geneller.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız günün başlangıcına bağlı zaman anlamı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyin başlangıcı ile bitki ve ayın ilk görünümü de kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Günün ilk bölümü, genel başlangıç düşüncesiyle kesişir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: وجه النهار أوله (jamhara); أتيته بوجه نهار وشباب نهار وصدر نهار أي في أوله (tahdhib); وجه النهار أي صدر النهار (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli zaman kalıbını günün başı veya ilk bölümü olarak açıklar ve daha genel bir başlangıç anlamı vermez.

branches.what_is_ar: وجه النهار؛ صدر النهار وأوله؛ مبدأ الشيء وأشرف ظاهره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس جهة السير ولا مقابلة الأشخاص

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözün kastını, görüşün doğruluğunu ve işin gereken biçimde yürütülmesini karşılayan çekirdek açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Amaçlanan yön, doğruluk ve uygun düzenleme bileşenlerini korur.

concept_gloss.text: sözün veya işin doğru yönü ve ona uygun düzenleme

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün amaçlanan yönü veya bir işin olması gereken doğru yolu ve bu yola uygun düzenlenmesidir. Özel bir kuruluşta, hiçbir işi doğru yürütemeyen beceriksiz kişiyi anlatır ve bir aktarımda bu beceriksizlik tuvaletini yapmaya kadar daraltılır.

facets.statement: Sözün amaçlanan yönünü ve görüşün doğru biçimini belirtir.
Bir işi olması gerektiği gibi düzenlemeyi veya doğru yolundan saptırmayı belirtir.
Özel bir kalıpta genel beceriksizliği, bir aktarımda ise tuvaletini yapmayı bile becerememeyi anlatır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir görüşün veya işin uygun ve doğru yolu kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğru yol ve uygunluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynakta verilen özel kalıpta kişinin genel beceriksizliği anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel kalıbın işlerini doğru yürütemeyen kişi anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, fiziksel yüzü veya salt uzamsal yönü değil, söz ve işte uygun yol ile doğruluğu anlatır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün amaçlanan yönünü, görüşün doğru biçimini, bir işi olması gerektiği gibi düzenlemeyi ve bu doğrultudan sapmayı verir. Beceriksiz kişiye ilişkin kalıp da işini doğru yürütememe çekirdeğine bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: işi gerektiği gibi düzenleyip her şeyi yerine koymak
hiçbir işi doğru yapamayan ahmak; ayrıca tuvaletini yapmayı bile beceremeyen kişi

lexicalization_scope.note: Söz ve işte uygun yol çekirdeği, görüş ve düzenleme kalıpları ile beceriksizlik bildiren özel kuruluş birbirine karıştırılmadan korunur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; doğru davranış yolunu bulma ve genel amaca uygunluk dalları, odak anlamın sınırlarını en iyi gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal söz ve görüşün yönünü, işi gereken biçimde düzenlemeyi ve bunun olumsuz kalıbını içerir; komşu dal kişinin doğru davranış yolunu bulmasına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözün kastı, görüşün yönü ve özel beceriksizlik kalıbı bu dalda yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin işin doğru tarafını bulması ve davranışında olgunluk göstermesi komşu dalda öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir işte doğru yaklaşımı bulup uygun davranmayı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğru yön ve gereken düzenleme imgesini korur; komşu dal amaca isabet ve düzgünlük anlamını daha geniş eylem alanlarına taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözün amaçlanan yönü ve belirli kuruluşlara bağlı beceriksizlik anlatımı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Söz, eylem, atış ve yönetimde hedefe uygunluk ile doğru çizgide olma daha genel kapsamlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir söz veya işin doğru ve amaca uygun olmasını anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: وجه الكلام السبيل التي تقصدها به وصرفت الشيء عن وجهه أي عن سننه (jamhara); هذا وجه الرأي أي هو الرأي نفسه وأحمق ما يتوجه (sihah); دبر الأمر على وجهه الذي ينبغي وأحمق ما يتوجه أي ما يحسن أن يأتي الغائط (tahdhib); أحمق ما يتوجه أي لا يستقيم في أمر من الأمور (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar söz, görüş ve işte amaçlanan doğru yol çekirdeğini paylaşır. Beceriksizlik kalıbı genel olarak hiçbir işi doğru yürütememe, daha dar bir aktarımda ise tuvaletini yapmayı becerememe biçiminde açıklanır.

branches.what_is_ar: الوجه في الرأي والكلام والأمر؛ السنن والصواب والتدبير الحسن؛ استقامة الأمر أو عدمها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الوجه العضوي ولا الجهة المحضة

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız yaşlı kişinin ileri yaşa geçmesini bildiren kaynakta verilen özel kuruluş için geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşın ilerlemesi ve ömrün son dönemine giriş anlamını korur.

concept_gloss.text: yaşlanıp ömrünün son dönemine girmek

concept_map.definition: Yaşlı bir kişinin yaşının ilerlemesi, ömrünün son dönemine girmesi ve gençlikten uzaklaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Yaşlı kişinin daha ileri yaşa geçmesini ve ömrünün son dönemine yaklaşmasını belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yaşlının ileri yaşa ulaşıp hayatının son dönemine girmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İleri yaşa geçiş anlamını doğal biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız yaşlı kişiyi konu alan özel eylem kuruluşunda geçerlidir; genel yönelme anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yaşlı kişinin ömründe ileri gidip gençlikten uzaklaşmasını, yaşının büyümesini ve hayatın son dönemine yönelmesini aynı özel kuruluşla açıklar. Dalın yaşlanma ve ömrün gerileme dönemi çerçevesi buna uygundur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yaşlı kişinin ileri yaşa geçmesini bildiren özel sözlüksel kuruluşla sınırlıdır ve yalın anlama genişletilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel yaşlılık ve zihinsel düşüşlü aşırı yaşlılık, özel kuruluşun sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel bir kuruluşla yaşın ilerleyip ömrün son dönemine girmesini anlatır; komşu dal yaşlı kişiyi ve yaşlılık halini genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir eylem kuruluşu yaşlı kişinin daha da ilerleyen yaşa geçişini vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaşlı erkek ve kadın adları ile yaşlılık durumu genel olarak kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin yaşlanmasını ve yaşlılık durumunu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız yaşın ilerlemesini bildirir; komşu dal ise aşırı yaşlılığın getirdiği zihinsel düşüşü zorunlu olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İleri yaşa geçiş vardır, zihinsel yeti kaybı zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aşırı yaşlılıkta bilinç ve bilgi yetilerinin bozulması belirleyici koşuldur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insan ömrünün ileri ve gerileyen dönemleriyle ilgilidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: توجه الشيخ ولى وأدبر (maqayis); توجه الشيخ إذا ولى وكبر (sihah); إذا كبر سنه قد توجه (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel kuruluşu yaşlı kişinin yaşının ilerlemesi ve ömrünün geriye kalan son dönemine girmesi olarak ortak biçimde açıklar.

branches.what_is_ar: كبر السن والإدبار في العمر؛ توجه الشيخ إذا ولى وكبر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس التوجه إلى جهة ولا الجاه

concept_gloss.applicability: Yavrunun sunumunu ve annenin bu sunumla doğurmasını birlikte açıklayan özel doğum terimidir.

error_profile.preserves: Doğum, önce çıkma ve el ya da ön ayak koşullarını korur.

concept_gloss.text: doğumda ellerin veya ön ayakların önce çıkması

concept_map.definition: Doğum sırasında bir yavrunun ellerinin veya ön ayaklarının bedeninin öteki bölümlerinden önce çıkması ve annenin yavruyu bu biçimde doğurmasıdır.

facets.statement: Yavrunun doğumda ellerinin veya ön ayaklarının önce çıkmasını belirtir.
Annenin yavruyu elleri veya ön ayakları önce çıkacak biçimde doğurmasını belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan yavrusunun elleri önce çıkacak biçimde doğması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan doğumunda ellerin önce çıkması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvan yavrusunun ön ayakları önce çıkacak biçimde doğması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan doğumunda ön ayakların önce çıkması koşulunu korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, doğumda ellerin veya ön ayakların önce çıkması koşuluna bağlıdır; genel doğum ya da toplumsal itibar değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğum sırasında yavrunun ellerinin veya ön ayaklarının rahimden önce çıkmasını ve annenin onu bu biçimde doğurmasını açıkça verir. Dalın doğum sunumuna ilişkin çerçevesi bu koşulu tam korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: elleri veya ön ayakları önce çıkan yavru
yavruyu elleri veya ön ayakları önce çıkacak biçimde doğurmak

lexicalization_scope.note: Önce elleri çıkan yavruyu bildiren biçim ile annenin bu biçimde doğurmasını bildiren kalıp ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; ayakların önce çıktığı karşı sunum ile yavruyu karşılayan kişi, doğum olayındaki en açıklayıcı iki sınırı verir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ellerin veya ön ayakların önce çıkmasını, komşu dal ise ayakların baştan önce çıkmasını belirtir; ayrım doğumda öne gelen uzuv üzerindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğumda ellerin veya ön ayakların önce çıkması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğumda ayakların baştan önce çıkması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yavrunun olağan dışı bir uzuv sunumuyla doğmasını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yavrunun çıkış biçimini niteler; komşu dal ise çıkan yavruyu karşılayan kişinin eylemini veya görevini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yavrunun doğumda hangi uzvunun önce çıktığını niteleyen sunum biçimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğum sırasında yavruyu karşılayıp alan kişinin görevidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğum olayının katılımcıları ve aşamalarıyla ilgilidir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: للمهر إذا خرجت يداه من الرحم وجيه (maqayis); للولد إذا خرجت يداه من الرحم أولا وجيه (sihah); أوجهت به أمه حين ولدته إذا خرج يداه أولا (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yavrunun doğum kanalından elleri veya ön ayakları önce çıkması koşulunda birleşir; adlandırma hem yavruya hem de annenin doğurma eylemine uygulanır.

branches.what_is_ar: الوجيه من المولود إذا خرجت يداه قبل غيرهما؛ أوجهت به أمه إذا ولدته كذلك
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس وجاهة المنزلة ولا الوجه العضوي العام

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız klasik şiirin uyak yapısındaki bu belirli konumu adlandıran teknik kullanım için geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Teknik konumu ve iki uyak öğesi arasındaki harf olma niteliğini korur.

concept_gloss.text: kurucu uzun ünlü ile ana uyak harfi arasındaki harf

concept_map.definition: Klasik uyak düzeninde kurucu uzun ünlü ile şiirin ana uyak harfi arasında bulunan harftir.

facets.statement: Kurucu uzun ünlü ile ana uyak harfi arasındaki harfi belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Teknik uyak çözümlemesinde harfin konumunu kısa ve anlaşılır biçimde açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki belirli uyak öğesi arasında bulunma özelliğini bağlam içinde korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu, uyak düzenindeki belirli bir harftir; genel yöneltme eylemi veya bağımsız bir hareket adı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadelerinin tümü şiirde kurucu uzun ünlü ile ana uyak harfi arasında bulunan harfi tanımlar. Geçici çerçevedeki hareket seçeneği kaynak ifadesiyle desteklenmediğinden tanım yalnız aradaki harf olarak düzeltilmiştir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kurucu uzun ünlü ile ana uyak harfi arasındaki harf

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, teknik şiir teriminin yalın biçimini tanımlar; başka yöneltme kalıpları bu teknik anlama taşınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kurucu uzun ünlü ve ana uyak harfi, teknik terimin iki yanındaki konumu doğrudan gösterdiği için seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iki öğe arasındaki harfi, komşu dal ise bu düzeni kuran uzun ünlünün kendisini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kurucu uzun ünlü ile ana uyak harfi arasındaki harftir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uyakta kalıcı olan ve ana uyak harfinden bir harf uzakta duran kurucu uzun ünlüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aynı klasik uyak dizisinin bitişik öğelerini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ana uyak harfinden önceki belirli ara konumu, komşu dal ise dizelerin bağlandığı ana uyak harfini gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kurucu uzun ünlü ile ana uyak harfi arasındaki ara harftir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ara harf ile ana uyak harfi
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Şiir boyunca birliği sağlayan ana uyak harfinin kendisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da şiirin uyak örgüsündeki harf konumlarını adlandırır.

text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ

baseline.text: Kim iyilik yaparak kendini Allah'a teslim ederse en sağlam kulpa tutunmuş olur. İşlerin sonu Allah'a varır.

findings.text: Kendini Allah'a teslim etmek etkinliği silmez; yönü sağlamlaştırıp onu becerili ve yararlı davranış olarak dışa vurur.
Sağlam bağa tutunmak, bütün örtü ve destekler kaybolduğunda bile insanı taşıyan güvenilir bir bağlantıya sarılmaktır.
Her iş, ilk adımından sonra da süren ve onu nihai sonucuna bağlayan bir iz taşır.

activation_trace.role: Handing a thing over supplies active transfer of control as the opening movement.
Direction and destination make the face an orienting vector rather than appearance alone.
Well-made and beneficent action makes ethical execution internal to the surrender.
Holding, preserving, and attaching supply the active grip that follows transfer.
Settled trust in something relied upon supplies relational security.
Structural strengthening makes that trust load-bearing rather than merely affective.
The ending and what an act leaves behind locate the horizon of the grip.
Affair as state or case gives the outcome universal practical scope.

changed_reading.after: Surrender is a directed transfer of the self that immediately becomes ethical agency and a load-bearing grip; security rests in where affairs end, not in passivity.
changed_reading.before: Surrender is passive resignation followed by reassurance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins surrendering the face toward God, doing good, gripping the firmest handle, and the outcome of affairs.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self is handed over and aimed toward God, yet the result is not inert release: ethical excellence and deliberate holding form one action, while final control lies where every affair ends.

activation_trace.role: The front or beginning supplies the opening phase of the process.
Continued attachment supplies persistence between opening and outcome.
Reliance on the dependable supplies continuity through intervening changes.
One thing following another supplies temporal succession rather than a single instant.
Final consequence closes the course opened by the face.
Plural affairs provide the changing states carried through that course.

changed_reading.after: The ayah diagrams persistence from first orientation through successive affairs to final consequence.
changed_reading.before: The ayah names one conversion moment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The face at the opening of orientation is paired with the aftermath and outcome of all affairs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Images of a front or beginning, succession, and final aftermath stretch the ayah across a whole course: the grip carries an initial orientation through changing states to their consequence.

activation_trace.role: Soundness free of outward and inward defect supplies integrated condition.
The visible front supplies the public surface of orientation.
Face standing for the person extends the act from surface to whole self.
The two-faced image supplies the live failure mode of divided presentation.
Beneficent and well-executed action tests whether orientation is embodied.

changed_reading.after: The face gathers the whole person into one sound, ethically enacted orientation and excludes a merely two-faced profession.
changed_reading.before: The face marks a visible profession of allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The surrendered face stands beside the state of being a doer of good.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because face can be visible front, whole person, or a divided social presentation, sound surrender plus good action closes the gap between outward direction and inward self.

activation_trace.role: Direction and pathing make the focus face the steering point among rival routes.
Attachment supplies traction that resists being redirected.
Deviation from guidance supplies the first counter-trajectory.
A traversable extended road turns guidance into an actual route.
Turning the back supplies an embodied reversal of the focus orientation.
Heaviness in the ear shows how a rival orientation blocks reception.
Going behind another supplies the mechanics of chosen following.
Finding something already present supplies the immediate basis claimed for inherited practice.
The alternate mapped image of ancestry sharpens found practice into inherited traction rather than evidence.
Fatherhood and formation identify the social channel carrying that traction.

changed_reading.after: Surrender is an embodied rerouting of attention and allegiance, with a grip strong enough to resist inherited and seductive trajectories.
changed_reading.before: Surrender is an inward one-time assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies rival routes: diversion from a path, bodily turning away with blocked hearing, following revelation or inherited practice, and a call toward punishment. Directing the face and gripping therefore become rerouting and traction against competing inheritances, not a private mood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, deviation, turning, hearing blockage, following, finding, and fathers; I infer that the focus grip gives counter-traction against inherited or distracting routes. Alternatively, the context may only contrast belief and unbelief without a spatial mechanics.
structural_cues: 31:6 diverts from a path, 31:7 turns away, and 31:21 contrasts following what descended with following what was found upon the fathers.
The repeated directional constructions lead directly into the focus face directed toward God.

activation_trace.role: Holding and preserving supply the human point of attachment.
Structural firmness makes the attachment load-bearing.
Propping a thing with a support supplies the load-bearing analogy.
Fixed rooted stability supplies the anchoring action of the mountains.
Motion, oscillation, and leaning supply the instability being prevented.

changed_reading.after: The firm handle is a stabilizing attachment that keeps oriented action from swaying, including through supports not fully visible to the holder.
changed_reading.before: The firm handle is mainly subjective reassurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heavens, supports, planted anchors, and prevention of sway create an engineering analogy for the focus grip: surrender stabilizes action through a support structure whose full means need not be visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, anchoring, sway, holding, and firmness; I infer an analogy from cosmic stabilization to moral orientation. The alternative is that 31:10 remains a creation sign and only generally strengthens trust.
structural_cues: 31:10 pairs heavens without visible pillars with mountains placed so the earth does not sway.
The focus construction joins holding, a handle whose root lacks a packet inventory, and superlative firmness.

activation_trace.role: Handing over the affair supplies ultimate allegiance without erasing the actor's choices.
A chosen direction supplies the criterion by which nearer demands are ranked.
Beneficent action preserves goodness toward people while allegiance is bounded.
Sustained companionship supplies continued relationship after refusal.
Recognized good supplies the ethical quality governing that companionship.
Following behind supplies selective allegiance to a different path.
Return supplies the final direction that orders refusal and companionship alike.

changed_reading.after: Ultimate orientation supplies a criterion for refusing a wrongful command while continuing beneficent companionship.
changed_reading.before: Surrender means undifferentiated compliance and social withdrawal from dissenters.

context_deltas.mechanism: The refusal of a parental demand is immediately paired with good companionship, following a returning path, and return to God. Surrender to God thus ranks allegiances without licensing relational cruelty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, companionship, recognized good, following, and return; I infer a hierarchy of allegiance that preserves social goodness. A live alternative is that this is a case-specific exception rather than a general account of surrender.
structural_cues: 31:15 places a negated obedience command beside an affirmative command to accompany the same parents well.
Its sequence then moves from following a path to the explicit return to God.

activation_trace.role: Well-executed beneficence supplies the ethical work that must continue.
Holding oneself to an attachment supplies persistence rather than possession alone.
Strengthening and taking the firmest course supply durability under pressure.
Restraining the self from panic supplies the internal mechanics of endurance.
Binding the heart decisively to an affair supplies resolved continuation.
Remaining on a purpose and proceeding along a road connects resolve to motion.

changed_reading.after: Holding the handle is repeatedly restraining panic and continuing good action along a resolved course when consequences arrive.
changed_reading.before: Holding the handle is possessing a secure belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative chain of worship, public good, restraint from wrong, and endurance under what befalls turns gripping from a static possession into sustained self-command and resolved continuation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-restraint, decisive resolve, continued purpose, and the focus grip; I infer that the handle is enacted as durable discipline. Alternatively, patience and resolve may list virtues without defining the focus metaphor.
structural_cues: 31:17 moves through repeated imperatives before naming endurance under what strikes the addressee.
The focus perfect construction presents the grip as an achieved attachment whose effects continue.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from outward and inward defect supplies integrated soundness.
The visible front anchors the reading in bodily presentation.
Two-faced presentation supplies the divided condition that integrity excludes.
Good and well-proportioned action supplies the behavioral test of integration.
Tilting cheek and neck away in pride supplies a bodily anti-orientation.
Moderation between extremes supplies measured outward movement.
Lowering by restraint supplies measured vocal presence.
Emergence into view supplies the exterior register explicitly named by the context.
The inside of a thing supplies the corresponding interior register.

changed_reading.after: Directing the face coordinates inner allegiance with cheek, gait, voice, and measured public conduct.
changed_reading.before: Directing the face is a verbal or visible profession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cheek, gait, voice, visible blessing, and hidden interior extend the focus face into a whole embodied public posture. The surrendered face is neither cosmetic nor disembodied; its inner and outer directions agree in measured conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily posture, moderation, lowering, exterior, and interior; I infer that face is a synecdoche for integrated conduct. The alternative is that face simply means the whole self, with no special public-postural force.
structural_cues: 31:18-19 correct cheek, walking, and voice in a negative-positive bodily sequence.
31:20 immediately pairs blessings described as visible and inward.

activation_trace.role: A front or beginning supplies each newly opening phase.
Dependable reliance supplies stability inside recurring change.
Successive replacement supplies the focus-side pattern of alternation.
One thing entering the interior of another supplies reciprocal phase transition.
The alternate mapped image of thickening darkness preserves the nocturnal materiality of one phase.
Continuous running supplies movement through the cycle.
A fixed temporal limit gives recurrent motion a bounded horizon.

changed_reading.after: The divine outcome is also the horizon governing recurrent transitions, while the holder remains oriented inside their motion.
changed_reading.before: The outcome of affairs is only a distant terminal endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night enters day and day enters night while celestial bodies run to fixed limits. The focus outcome can therefore be read not only as a terminal point but as the governing horizon of recurrent phase changes within which the grip remains stable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal entry, darkness, running, allotted limit, succession, and trust; I infer stable orientation through cycles rather than escape from change. A live alternative is that the cosmic sequence only proves divine power.
structural_cues: 31:29 repeats reciprocal insertion of night and day, then says each celestial body runs to a named limit.
The focus pairs attachment with succession and final aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Holding and attachment supply continuity across changing conditions.
Reliance on the dependable distinguishes sustained trust from episodic alarm.
A vessel moving through water supplies the navigational frame.
Flowing motion supplies the calm pre-crisis phase.
An all-covering event supplies sudden loss of ordinary bearings.
Intermixed turbulence supplies the destabilizing crisis itself.
Exclusive separation from partnership supplies crisis-induced single orientation.
Escape by separation supplies the transition out of danger.
Moderation between extremes supplies one post-rescue continuation.
Betrayal and failure to fulfill supply the opposite post-rescue break.

changed_reading.after: The secure handle is maintained orientation before, during, and after instability, especially when urgency recedes.
changed_reading.before: The secure handle is a refuge seized at the emergency moment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A vessel moves by grace, a wave engulfs, exclusive devotion appears, rescue reaches land, and response divides into moderation or betrayal. The secure grip is continuity of orientation across calm, emergency, and aftermath, not merely an emergency hold.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voyage, flow, engulfment, turbulence, exclusive devotion, rescue, moderation, and betrayal; I infer that grip names temporal continuity and is tested after rescue. Alternatively, the sea scene may be only an example of inconsistency.
structural_cues: 31:31-32 form a temporal sequence of voyage, engulfment, exclusive calling, rescue, and divergent aftermath.
The focus perfect verb of gripping sits between prior rival following and this later test of persistence.

activation_trace.role: Personal delivery of the self supplies an act that cannot be outsourced.
The final consequence of an act supplies the account at issue.
Each affair or case supplies the material whose outcome returns.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the exact substitution explicitly denied.
The alternate mapped image of cutting supplies an exploratory severing of proxy channels.
Descent by birth supplies the strongest ordinary bond that still cannot transfer the account.
Deception by what flashes without lasting supplies false present security.
Risk born of ignorance about aftermath directly obscures the focus outcome.

changed_reading.after: Each person's surrendered orientation and consequence are nontransferable; lineage and present glitter cannot grip on another's behalf.
changed_reading.before: All affairs returning to God is a general cosmic statement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated denial that parent and child can stand in for one another makes the focus outcome personally nontransferable. The doubled warning against glittering deception prevents present appearance or lineage from masquerading as a substitute grip.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied substitution, birth relation, deceptive flash, and ignorance of aftermath; I infer that the focus singular whoever marks a nontransferable attachment. The cutting image is an exploratory aid; the alternative reading needs no severance metaphor.
structural_cues: 31:33 reverses parent and child in two parallel denials of substitution.
A true promise is then opposed by two warnings not to be deceived.

activation_trace.role: Trust and repose in the dependable supply certainty of relation rather than certainty of forecast.
Final aftermath supplies the unknown horizon entrusted to God.
Affairs as changing cases supply what cannot be forecast in detail.
Practical knowing supplies the capacity explicitly denied to each self.
The alternate mapped image of road alignment and wind direction makes unknown routing materially visible.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies tomorrow's open practical content.
The following day supplies the near future that remains unpossessed.
Loss of life supplies the terminal circumstance whose place is unknown.

changed_reading.after: The grip yields confidence without foreknowledge: destination is entrusted while route, acquisition, and place of death remain unknown.
changed_reading.before: A firm grip should yield confidence by making the future legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated nonknowledge of tomorrow's acquisition and the land of death separates secure attachment from prediction. The holder can have a dependable orientation while neither route nor terminal circumstance is possessed as information.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonknowledge, earning, tomorrow, death, and an alternate route image; I infer that the grip is relational security under an unknown itinerary, not predictive mastery. The route image may remain form-distant while the epistemic contrast stands without it.
structural_cues: 31:34 repeats that no self knows, first about tomorrow's earning and then about the land of death.
The focus gives God the outcome without giving the holder a map of intervening affairs.

remaining_uncertainties: The focus root ع ر و has no branch inventory, so its handle function is used only as a structural cue and never branch-cited.
Alternate mapped-root images such as ancestry, cutting, darkness, and route alignment may be form-distant; they change the reading but remain explicitly exploratory.
The context sequences support causal and temporal mechanisms, but they do not prove that each mechanism is a lexical sense of the focus words.
strongest_changes: Transfer and grip are complementary: relinquishing final control enables directed ethical agency rather than passivity.
The firm handle becomes a load-bearing stabilizer against sway, including where support is not fully visible.
Ultimate orientation ranks obedience while preserving good companionship and embodied social integrity.
The maritime sequence makes grip continuity across calm, crisis, rescue, and aftermath rather than emergency sincerity alone.
Outcome becomes both nontransferable and unknowable in detail: lineage cannot substitute, and trust does not provide a forecast.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated unusually concrete mechanics without forcing a single synthesis: inherited traction through the alternate ancestry mapping of و ج د, structural stabilization, reciprocal temporal ingress, severed substitution through the alternate cutting mapping of ج ز ي, and route-without-foreknowledge through the alternate mapping of د ر ي. Contractual and ladder-bucket readings remain live but contained.

activation_trace.role: Advance payment in an exchange supplies present commitment before later settlement.
Delivery to another supplies entrustment of the self or affair.
Worship and the worshipped identify God as the party receiving ultimate allegiance.
A confirmed covenant supplies the binding security of the undertaking.
A substitute, recourse, or guarantee supplies settlement and retained liability.
Affairs as cases supply what the undertaking encompasses.

changed_reading.after: Faith can be carried as placing the self into a binding undertaking whose security and settlement are with God.
changed_reading.before: Faith is private confidence in eventual safety.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses into commercial and legal imagery. It remains anchored by focus branches converging on advance payment or delivery, covenant, guarantee, and outcome; downstream prose should present it as an analogy of secured entrustment, not claim that the ayah lexically denotes a sale.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Surrendering the face, gripping what is firmly secured, and the outcome of affairs all occur inside the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means of ascent supplies vertical movement rather than static submission.
A bucket with one handle supplies a concrete handled vessel that can be drawn.
Active holding supplies the human contact point in the apparatus.
A binding rope supplies the secured line by which ascent or drawing can occur.
A difficult rising path supplies the strenuous terrain traversed by the apparatus.

changed_reading.after: The handle can be imagined as part of an apparatus by which surrender becomes ascent, drawing, or being drawn across difficult terrain.
changed_reading.before: The handle is a static object already possessed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately material montage: ladder, one-handled bucket, binding rope, grip, and steep ascent are branch-distant but all attach to focus roots or its uncited handle construction. It should be rendered as an exploratory apparatus for ascent or drawing, never as an etymological unification; the handle root itself has no packet branch inventory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines surrender, gripping, a handle, maximal firmness, and aftermath.

activation_trace.role: The stung person named through hope of soundness or surrender supplies afflicted vulnerability at the start.
A remaining measure that preserves life supplies the minimum capacity still able to hold.
Reliance on the dependable supplies support not contingent on bodily invulnerability.
Comprehensive covering supplies the experience of being overwhelmed.
Intermixed turbulence supplies the unstable crisis around the vulnerable holder.
Escape by separation supplies rescue without erasing the need for post-crisis continuity.

changed_reading.after: Surrender may begin from an already afflicted or overwhelmed condition whose remaining capacity grips what can carry it beyond crisis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Calling the stung person sound or surrendered is a lexical oddity, and linking it to the later wave is abductive. It remains anchored in the focus surrender and grip plus the packet's engulfment and rescue sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as a vulnerability reading, not identify surrender with injury.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from surrender through active gripping, while 31:32 supplies overwhelming crisis and rescue.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Orientation handed over becomes sound beneficent action.** **س ل م B001** supplies soundness and safety and **B012** handing over; **و ج ه B002/B008** orientation and proper course; **ح س ن B002** beneficent skilled action. The face is not merely lowered; its direction is delivered while the subject actively does good. I infer that surrender corrects orientation, and corrected orientation becomes competent benefit. The ayah preserves both yielding and agency.
2. **Firm holding answers exposure.** **م س ك B001/B003** is holding and a sustaining remnant; **ع ر و B001/B008** supplies bare exposure and being left unsupported; **و ث ق B001–B004** gives settled reliance, firm fastening, and covenant. The packet’s **ع ر و** inventory does not supply a handle image; instead, its exposure branch makes the construction read as holding fast precisely where cover or support is absent. I infer that trusted fastening prevents exposed agency from collapse. This coexists with the conventional surface construction without importing an unattested branch label.
3. **Every affair carries a rear trace toward its outcome.** **ع ق ب B002/B005–B006** supplies heel, succession, and outcome; **ء م ر B001** affairs. The final clause places all matters’ *ʿāqibah* toward God after the individual act of holding. I infer that choices leave a trace that continues after the immediate step. Outcome is thus the following edge of present affairs, not an unrelated terminal event.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 31:32’s wave-canopy made the exposure branch of **ع ر و B001/B008** unexpectedly concrete: all ordinary cover and footing can vanish while exclusive orientation remains. Ayah 31:33 then sharpened *ʿāqibah* as an outcome no kin can absorb for another.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Directional handover that restores soundness.** Lexical evidence: `س ل م B012` is handing over or consigning, `س ل م B001` is soundness and safety, `و ج ه B002` is orientation, and `ح س ن B002` is skillful beneficent action. Structural cue: the face is handed `إِلَى ٱللَّهِ` while the person remains actively characterized as a doer of good; 31:18's turned cheek and 31:21's rival directions supply contrasts. Assigned role: the face represents public orientation, handover fixes its destination, and beneficent action tests the orientation. Abductive move (inferred): surrender becomes sound when it orders the whole outward self toward a source and issues in competent good. Reading change: submission is an active reorientation, not erasure of agency.

2. **A load-bearing grip that reaches the outcome.** Lexical evidence: `م س ك B001` is holding, preserving, and cleaving to; `و ث ق B002` is firm fastening; `ع ق ب B006` is final outcome; and `ء م ر B001` is an affair. Structural cue: the material image of gripping a firm bond is followed by the temporal destination of all affairs; 31:17's inward resolve and 31:24's later compulsion flank it. Assigned role: the grip maintains connection through changing affairs, and the outcome discloses why firmness matters. Abductive move (inferred): reliable orientation functions as a supporting attachment that can bear temporal and social force. Reading change: the firm bond is not merely something believed; it is what carries a practitioner through to the end of affairs.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - 31:24 made voluntary handover newly legible by contrast with later compulsion toward a dense punishment. 31:27 then expanded the bond's reliability: the words of the destination-source outlast every imaginable material writing supply.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction that opens a fresh whoever-condition while keeping contact with the prior refusal scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) launches 31:22 as a fresh universal condition, not as a detached aphorism. Its connective force still keeps the new offer in contact with the refusal of 31:21, so the ayah turns ancestral-following resistance into the opening of God-directed surrender.

topics.headline: resumptive condition launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens a new rule-like condition while still answering the prior scene.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction precedes the conditional particle and is compatible with resumptive discourse launch.

topics.headline: contrast bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the condition as an alternative to the prior refusal rather than a disconnected maxim.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence ties the new conditional to the previous ancestral-following refusal in 31:21.

words.gloss_range: open conditional subject, unrestricted by gender or number and governing the surrender clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) makes the subject radically open: whoever enters the condition may be the one described. That openness is not vague, because the particle governs the jussive surrender, carries the subject through the intervening excellence qualifier, and moves the sentence toward the secured result introduced by the answer-frame.

topics.headline: open conditional subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not naming a fixed group but opening the offer to any person who fulfills the condition.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as the conditional subject governing the jussive verb.

topics.headline: condition-result frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the syntax from whoever-condition through the excellence qualifier into the confirmed result.
topics.reason: The conditional protasis is linked to the apodosis introduced by the later answer particle and certainty construction.

words.gloss_range: Form IV jussive act of handing over the presented self toward God, with safety and wholeness pressure retained beneath surrender
words.prose: {{ar:يُسْلِمْ}} ({{tr:yuslim}}) is not a bare label for being submissive; as a Form IV jussive it makes the open subject actively hand over his own orientation toward God. The root keeps safety, peace, and wholeness under the act, so surrender is heard as entry into soundness rather than mere loss. The recurring face-surrender formula also links this wording with 2:112 and 4:125, while the reported Form II variant only sharpens the yielding force without replacing the local Form IV parse.
words.root_gloss_range: root range joining safety, soundness, peace, and surrender; locally Form IV with object and endpoint selects directed self-surrender

topics.headline: directed Form IV surrender
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices surrender as an active, directed handing-over of orientation, not as a generic intransitive state.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV and governs both the possessed face as object and the divine endpoint through the preposition.

topics.headline: conditional jussive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the act as the condition to be fulfilled, not as a report that has already happened.
topics.reason: The imperfect is jussive under the conditional particle.

topics.headline: wholeness under surrender
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that surrender carries peace and soundness pressure, while local grammar still selects directed surrender as the operative sense.
topics.reason: The root field supports safety and soundness pressure, but the object-plus-endpoint frame selects surrender rather than a free safety reading.

topics.headline: formula and form contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a known face-surrender formula (2:112; 4:125), with variant form evidence adding intensity but not changing the canonical form.
topics.reason: The cited formula parallels are concrete, and the Form II variant can clarify contrast without controlling the local Form IV surface; the intra-surah comparison with 31:30 remains a thematic echo.

words.gloss_range: possessed face as object of surrender, carrying self, presentation, direction, and aim in one concrete image
words.prose: {{ar:وَجْهَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:wajhahū}}) makes the surrender personal and embodied: the object is his own face, the front by which the self faces and aims. The local metaphor layers face, self, direction, and purpose, so submission becomes spatially directed rather than merely inward. The same face-surrender formula recurs in 2:112 and 4:125, while broader uses of the face-root for the divine presence (2:115; 55:27; 76:9) remain a narrowed echo, not the local referent.
words.root_gloss_range: root range of face, front, direction, aim, and orientation; locally the possessed noun makes the submitted object the person's own presented self

topics.headline: possessed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is handed over is the person's own presented self, not an abstract act detached from the subject.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as object of the verb and carries a possessive suffix tied to the conditional subject.

topics.headline: face orientation metaphor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees surrender as the turning of identity and direction, not only as an inner attitude.
topics.reason: The physical front-image is locally licensed by the directional verb frame and endpoint phrase.

topics.headline: formula and directional arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local face-surrender formula with the ayah's closing outcome, while divine-face root echoes stay secondary.
topics.reason: The formula parallels and local opening-to-close arc are concrete; the divine-face references are relevant root echoes but do not change the local possessed human face.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking God as endpoint of the surrendered orientation
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) gives the surrendered face God as its destination, not a vague beneficiary. It marks movement toward an endpoint, and its repetition near the close of the ayah makes the personal direction at word 5 answer to the universal destination at word 17.

topics.headline: personal endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that surrender is aimed toward God as endpoint, not merely performed for vague benefit.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as the endpoint of the surrender construction.

topics.headline: directional bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first direction phrase as the personal half of a frame completed by the coda's universal endpoint.
topics.reason: The same preposition recurs in the coda, and the clause structure supports a movement from condition to universal closure.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the definite endpoint of the surrendered face
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) fixes the endpoint of surrender as the named God, not an abstract sacred destination. The derivational field may add worship, refuge, and bewilderment pressure, but the local force is the proper name governed by the directional phrase. This first occurrence also begins the ayah's divine-name bracket, answered by the endpoint of all affairs at word 18.
words.root_gloss_range: root and derivational field tied to deity, worship, refuge, and debated bewilderment pressure; locally the proper name fixes the endpoint as God

topics.headline: named divine endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surrender terminates in the definite divine name, not in an unnamed religious category.
topics.reason: The proper name is genitive after the directional preposition and functions as the endpoint of the surrender frame.

topics.headline: refuge and worship pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the submitted orientation resolving disorientation into refuge and devotion, while the local word remains the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is meaningful as lexical pressure but does not replace the proper-name function in the local grammar.

topics.headline: divine-name bracket
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees human agency framed between God as the endpoint of surrender and God as the endpoint of all affairs.
topics.reason: The divine name occurs in the first directional unit and again in the closing coda.

topics.headline: certainty-particle comparison
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row's payoff belongs more directly to the certainty construction than to this occurrence of the divine name.
topics.reason: The comparison has a possible ayah-level interest, but for this word it mainly concerns the certainty particle and adds no distinct payoff to the divine-name endpoint.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial conjunction introducing the state in which surrender occurs
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) here works as the circumstantial connector: surrender is performed while the subject is in the state named by the following clause. That keeps excellence simultaneous with surrender rather than a later add-on.

topics.headline: circumstantial connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that excellence qualifies the surrender at the moment it is made.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following nominal clause as a circumstantial clause linked to the surrender verb.

words.gloss_range: explicit independent pronoun that stabilizes the circumstantial nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) makes the circumstantial clause explicit instead of letting the subject remain merely understood. The pronoun gives the excellence predicate a stable subject, so the ayah speaks of a standing state accompanying surrender.

topics.headline: explicit state subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the excellence clause is a full state-predication about the submitter, not a loose adjective.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is the subject of the nominal circumstantial clause and refers back to the conditional subject.

words.gloss_range: indefinite Form IV active participle naming an ongoing excellence-producing state within the condition
words.prose: {{ar:مُحْسِنٌۭ}} ({{tr:muḥsinun}}) is the state in which the surrender must occur: an active participle, indefinite and open, naming someone characterized by producing well-formed good. The root keeps beauty and ethical goodness together, so the condition is not bare compliance. The same excellence clause accompanies the face-surrender formula in 2:112 and 4:125, making it an invariant qualifier here.
words.root_gloss_range: root range joining beauty, goodness, excellence, and well-formed action; locally the participle selects an agent characterized by producing good

topics.headline: ongoing excellence state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result is attached to surrender performed in an ongoing excellence-state, not to unqualified submission.
topics.reason: The active participle predicates the circumstantial state of the conditional subject.

topics.headline: indefinite open quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quality as available to any submitter rather than as a closed class label.
topics.reason: The predicate is indefinite with tanwīn, so it characterizes a state rather than naming a fixed group.

topics.headline: beauty and goodness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses ethical excellence as beautiful and well-formed action, while local form keeps the meaning on the active agent.
topics.reason: The root field supports beauty and goodness pressure, but the local Form IV participle selects the agent who does good rather than abstract beauty itself.

topics.headline: formulaic excellence companion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes excellence as formulaically bound to face-surrender in the cited parallels (2:112; 4:125).
topics.reason: The cited parallels preserve the same surrender-plus-excellence pattern.

words.gloss_range: apodosis particle turning the completed condition into a consequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge into the answer of the condition. It gathers surrender and the excellence-state into a consequence, so the grasping result follows the whole prior configuration.

topics.headline: apodosis hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that security is the grammatical consequence of the whole condition, not a separate statement.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the answer of the conditional, especially before the certainty particle plus perfect verb.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, marking the result as realized and verified
words.prose: {{ar:قَدِ}} ({{tr:qadi}}) turns the result from a bare promise into verified achievement. Because it stands before a perfect verb in the conditional answer, the open future-facing condition meets a completed result: whoever fulfills the condition is spoken of as already having secured the grasp.

topics.headline: verified perfect result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the handhold result is presented as realized, not merely possible.
topics.reason: Before the perfect verb, the particle has verification force rather than possibility force.

topics.headline: temporal compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the syntax compress open conditional action and completed security into one certainty effect.
topics.reason: The conditional protasis remains open while the apodosis uses the certainty particle with a perfect verb.

words.gloss_range: Form X perfect grasping, self-involving and achieved, taking its grasped object through the attachment preposition
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَمْسَكَ}} ({{tr:istamsaka}}) makes security tactile: the subject has actively sought and achieved a hold, and the thing held is reached through the attachment preposition rather than a bare object. The root adds retention and restraint to the grip; even the musk-retention note can survive only as clinging persistence, not as fragrance imagery.
